public.title: Employee Free Time
public.description: Each employee has nonoverlapping sorted busy intervals [start,end], with integer start strictly less than end. Return all positive-length finite intervals when every employee is free, sorted by start. Ignore unbounded time before the first or after the last busy interval; touching busy intervals leave no gap. There are 0 to 100 employees with at most 500 total intervals; endpoints from 0 to 1000000. With no busy interval return [].
hints: Find gaps in the union of all busy intervals.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: A sorted sweep merges busy intervals and emits a gap whenever the next start is beyond the current merged end. O(n log n) time.
